template_fit_notes: HL is the user's own confident retrospective attribution of all past musty-laundry incidents to detergent brand — a canonical T6 first-person past-experience heuristic that is structurally inapplicable because the detergent has been constant for over three years while the symptom only recently appeared.
engagement_risk_notes: The distractor is embedded directly in the user's reported belief ({DS} in xbase), so a model must take a position on the detergent-brand hypothesis and cannot sidestep it by describing rather than evaluating.
